title: TLS cert expiry never checked on load; expired cert breaks clients silently
description: tls.rs:33 load_or_generate_cert checks cert_path.exists() and key_path.exists() but never reads the cert's notAfter field. rcgen generates certs with 365-day validity. After one year, TLS connections fail silently (from the daemon's perspective — it never notices). Fix: on the load path, parse the DER cert, extract notAfter, and regenerate if within 30 days of expiry or already expired. At minimum, log the expiry date at startup.
